name: Bolar
text: Bolar is a variant spelling of the name Balor. The longer form Bola also names the same being. Balor is the one-eyed leader of the Fomorians in Irish legend. A reader who meets Bolar should turn to the fuller Balor entry. Bolar and Bola both point the same balanced world of myth.

attributes.attribute: a variant spelling of the name Balor
points to the Fomorian giant Balor

okr.objective: Flag Bolar and Bola as variant spellings of the god Balor.
key_results: Bolar is a variant spelling of Balor.
Bola is the same alternate form.
The full entry on Balor carries the story.
